ai.firstTurn: A<17: 50/50 DOUBLE_STRIKE or SUCK (aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> DOUBLE_STRIKE); A17+: always FELL. Never FELL on turn 1 below A17.
ai.spec:
getMove(roll):
if firstTurn:
  if asc >= 17: FELL
  else: aiRng.randomBoolean() ? DOUBLE_STRIKE : SUCK
roll2 = 100 (sentinel)
if roll < 20:
  if lastMove != FELL: FELL
  else: roll2 = aiRng.random(20, 99)   // reroll into 20-99 range
if roll < 60 or roll2 < 60:
  if not lastTwoMoves(DOUBLE_STRIKE): DOUBLE_STRIKE else SUCK
else if not lastTwoMoves(SUCK): SUCK
else: DOUBLE_STRIKE

turn SUCK: queues VampireAttack with damage precomputed via calculateDamageToPlayer(asc2 ? 12 : 10); after the hit, if the parasite is alive it heals min(attackDamage, player's unblocked damage taken).
turn STUNNED: does nothing except setMove(FELL) then IMMEDIATELY rollMove (same aiRng.random(99) call during its turn) which overwrites the move; net effect: history becomes [rolledMove, FELL], so FELL cannot be rolled directly after a stun (lastMove==FELL blocks the roll<20 branch) and lastTwoMoves checks see FELL as the previous move.
Stun trigger (Monster.cpp attackedUnblockedHelper): each instance of unblocked ATTACK damage decrements PLATED_ARMOR by 1; when PLATED_ARMOR reaches 0 this way, the current move is replaced with SHELLED_PARASITE_STUNNED (loses its next turn). Plated Armor never returns, so this happens at most once per combat.
PLATED_ARMOR 14 also grants 14 block at end of each of its turns (generic power rule); the prebattle BLOCK 14 covers turn 1.
FELL/DOUBLE_STRIKE/SUCK queue RollMove at end of turn; STUNNED rolls immediately.
historyRules: FELL never twice in a row (and never rolled on the turn immediately after a stun, see spec)
DOUBLE_STRIKE never three times in a row
SUCK never three times in a row
probabilities per roll: FELL 20%, DOUBLE_STRIKE 40%, SUCK 40% (with reroll redistribution when FELL is blocked)

name: Byrd

ai.firstTurn: roll consumed but ignored; aiRng.randomBoolean(0.375): true -> CAW (37.5%), false -> PECK (62.5%). Never starts with SWOOP.
ai.spec:
getMove(roll)  // only ever invoked while airborne; the grounded sequence is scripted in takeTurn
if firstTurn: aiRng.randomBoolean(0.375) ? CAW : PECK
if roll < 50:
  if lastTwoMoves(PECK): aiRng.randomBoolean(0.4) ? SWOOP : CAW
  else: PECK
else if roll < 70:
  if lastMove(SWOOP): aiRng.randomBoolean(0.375) ? CAW : PECK
  else: SWOOP
else:
  if lastMove(CAW): aiRng.randomBoolean(0.2857) ? SWOOP : PECK
  else: CAW

Flight (power semantics): while FLIGHT > 0 all incoming attack damage is halved (damage *= 0.5, applied after Vulnerable, floor at the end); each unblocked instance of attack damage > 0 decrements FLIGHT by 1; FLIGHT amount resets to (asc17 ? 4 : 3) at the start of each round.
Grounding: when FLIGHT is decremented from 1 to 0, the current move is immediately replaced with BYRD_STUNNED.
Grounded script: turn STUNNED: noOpRollMove (burns aiRng.random(99)), setMove(HEADBUTT). turn HEADBUTT: attack 3, setMove(FLY) (no aiRng burn). turn FLY: buff FLIGHT (asc17 ? 4 : 3), queue RollMove -> back to the normal airborne pattern.
turns PECK/SWOOP/CAW queue RollMove at end of turn.
historyRules: PECK never three times in a row
SWOOP never twice in a row
CAW never twice in a row
airborne probabilities per roll: PECK 50%, SWOOP 20%, CAW 30%
while grounded the move sequence is fixed: STUNNED -> HEADBUTT -> FLY -> (normal pattern)

values.lightspeed: the FLIGHT status bit is never cleared when the value hits 0 (setStatus leaves the bit set), so lightspeed keeps halving damage while grounded and resets FLIGHT to 3/4 at the start of the next round even before FLY is used; BYRD_FLY then adds +3/4 on top
values.game/wiki: losing all Flight removes the power: a grounded Byrd takes full damage and has no Flight until Go Airborne re-applies 3 (A17: 4)

conflicts.chosen: game/wiki behavior for power semantics; lightspeed for all move-selection logic

else if roll >= 70 and not lastTwoMoves(SUPPORT_BEAM): SUPPORT_BEAM
else if not lastTwoMoves(BEAM): BEAM
else: SUPPORT_BEAM

turn STASIS: stasisAction (see below); usedStasis = 1; next move rolled IMMEDIATELY (rollMove during its turn).
turn SUPPORT_BEAM: Automaton (slot 1) gains 12 block; next move rolled IMMEDIATELY.

stasisAction (card steal):
1. if drawPile and discardPile are both empty: do nothing (no STASIS power gained; the move still counts as used).
2. pile = drawPile if non-empty, else discardPile.
3. rarity priority: RARE if any present, else UNCOMMON if any, else COMMON if any; if the pile has no R/U/C cards at all (only BASIC/SPECIAL/CURSE/STATUS), pick uniformly over the whole pile with cardRandomRng.random(size-1).
4. otherwise: collect all cards of the target rarity, stable-sort that list by the fixed card-id sort order (cardSortedIdx), then pick uniformly among them with cardRandomRng.random(count-1).
5. remove the card from the pile and from combat (deck-size triggers fire); store it on the orb; orb gains the STASIS power.
On the orb's death, the stolen card is returned TO THE PLAYER'S HAND (add-to-combat triggers fire; standard hand-overflow to discard applies). Card is lost if the orb is never killed.
historyRules: STASIS at most once per orb; until used it has a 75% chance per roll
SUPPORT_BEAM never three times in a row
BEAM never three times in a row
after stasis is used: BEAM 70%, SUPPORT_BEAM 30% per roll

state (miscInfo): bits 0-1 = defensiveStanceUseCount (max 2 per combat); bit 0x4 = phase-2 flag.
getMove(roll):
if phase2 flag set:
  if lastMove != EXECUTE and moveHistory[1] != EXECUTE: EXECUTE   // Execute every 3rd turn in phase 2
  // else fall through to the shared table below
else (phase 1):
  if curHp < maxHp / 2: set phase2 flag; ANGER   // exactly once, on the first roll made at < 50% HP
  else if (getMonsterTurnNumber() + 1) % 4 == 0: TAUNT   // this roll selects the move for turns 4, 8, 12, ... (phase 1 only)
  // else fall through
shared table (phase 1 non-taunt turns, and phase-2 turns where EXECUTE is blocked):
  stanceThreshold = (asc19 ? 30 : 15)
  if roll <= stanceThreshold and lastMove != DEFENSIVE_STANCE and defensiveStanceUseCount < 2: ++useCount; DEFENSIVE_STANCE
  else if roll <= 30 and lastMove != GLOAT and lastMove != DEFENSIVE_STANCE: GLOAT
  else if roll <= 55 and lastMove != FACE_SLAP: FACE_SLAP
  else if lastMove != HEAVY_SLASH: HEAVY_SLASH
  else: FACE_SLAP

turn ANGER: remove all debuffs from self (negative STR floored to 0; removes Weak/Vulnerable/Poison/Shackled/etc.); gain STR (6 / 9@A4 / 12@A19); next move rolled IMMEDIATELY.
turn DEFENSIVE_STANCE: gain block (15 / 18@A9 / 20@A19) and METALLICIZE (5 / 6@A9 / 7@A19); next move rolled IMMEDIATELY.
turn GLOAT: gain STR (see conflicts: 2 / 3@A4 / 4@A19); next move rolled IMMEDIATELY.
turn TAUNT: WEAK 2 + VULNERABLE 2 on player (applied immediately, not queued); next move rolled IMMEDIATELY.
turn EXECUTE: attack 10 x2; RollMove queued.
turn FACE_SLAP: attack (asc4 ? 14 : 12); queue FRAIL 2, VULNERABLE 2; RollMove queued.
turn HEAVY_SLASH: attack (asc4 ? 18 : 16); RollMove queued.
historyRules: phase 1: TAUNT forced on turns 4, 8, 12, ... (roll made when (turnNumber+1)%4==0)
phase 2 entered on the first roll made while curHp < maxHp/2: ANGER once (removes debuffs), then EXECUTE unless it was used in either of the last two moves (net: EXECUTE every 3rd turn)
DEFENSIVE_STANCE: at most 2 uses per combat, never twice in a row; roll <= 15 (A19: <= 30)
GLOAT never after itself or after DEFENSIVE_STANCE
FACE_SLAP never twice in a row; HEAVY_SLASH never twice in a row (falls back to FACE_SLAP)
approximate per-roll odds below A19: STANCE 16%, GLOAT 15%, FACE_SLAP 25%, HEAVY_SLASH 44% (thresholds are inclusive <=)
